summary.text: Mark Schreiber is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 60 who has represented the district since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He lives in Emporia and has worked for KG&E and Westar Energy.

paragraphs.text: Mark Schreiber lived in Emporia, Kansas, as of February 2020, and earned a degree from Emporia State University.
His career experience includes working with KG&E and Westar Energy and as an operator of the Cradle to Career Literacy Center.

He has volunteered with the United Way of the Flint Hills, the Emporia Area Chamber of Commerce, the Emporia-Lyon County Area Metropolitan Planning Commission, SOS, the Emporia Community Foundation, Leadership Emporia and the Kansas Coalition Against Sexual and Domestic Violence.
Schreiber took office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2017.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, House Education, House Judiciary and Legislative Modernization committees.
He faces Democrat Maddison Glover in the general election.
